card.name: "And" before bedtime in dosing
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "meals" in dosing schedules, just before "at bedtime". Also weaker on a few linking words or commas in label sentences.

modes.label: Meals and bedtime
modes.description: The word "and" after a meal reference, leading into "at bedtime" in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: three bismuth subcitrate potassium, metronidazole and tetracycline hydrochloride capsules 4 times a day (after meals<< and>> at bedtime) for 10 days

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A "be" or comma in warning sentences about heart failure or sodium.
modes.example: If Ibuprofen Tablets is used in patients with severe heart failure<<,>> monitor patients for signs of worsening heart failure

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens and a dosing-text effect; the suppressed tokens relate to cooling and cold.
card.plain: It lights up on the "and" in "after meals and at bedtime" in dose schedules.
